## Clean-room checklist

- [ ] I worked from the public specs and open standards only.
- [ ] I did not open, clone or quote the private research repository, and nothing in this change
      links to it.
- [ ] I did not use REA, a decompiler or a browser-capture tool, and did not fetch the vendor's
      websites or the course hosts named in spec sources.
- [ ] No vendor code, text, images, templates, characters, icons or label wording is copied.
- [ ] Vendor trademarks appear only in docs, as plain "compatible with" statements.
- [ ] Course fixtures are packages we authored or output of open-source tools, never vendor players.
- [ ] Tests for a spec rule carry its tag in their title, for example `[rise:R11]` for rule 11 of
      `rise.md`.
